precision: FP32; TF32 disabled for matmul and cuDNN
grid: 518x518 reference, nearest resampling of original depth, identical GT-only finite support inclusive [0.3,30] m
aspect_preserving: original BGR image through historical DAV2 image2tensor, cubic lower_bound, multiple14; normalized RGB; bilinear output resize align_corners=True to common518 grid
evaluation: pixel-pooled AbsRel/RMSE/MAE/delta1 with common prediction clamp[1e-6,30]; uncapped metrics also retained
scale: arithmetic mean over images of each valid-GT-support median raw pred/GT and median raw log-ratio, before cap
invalid: fail run on any nonfinite/nonpositive prediction on fixed GT support; do not discard prediction-dependent pixels

head_only.module: full original depth_head (DPTHead), encoder and focal auxiliary frozen/eval
head_only.lr_selection: one epoch per candidate, seed20260711, lowest full-validation uncapped pooledAbsRel; fresh initial checkpoint for every pilot and formal run
head_only.loss: mean absolute log-depth + 0.1 * metric MAE; no adapter-specific regularizers
head_only.selection: minimum uncapped validation pooledAbsRel; first epoch wins exact ties
head_only.historical_DP_RHR: 30epochs,batch4,AdamW1e-4,wd1e-4,AbsRel validation selection; 3500train/750val; full precision new head forward versus historical runtime as documented
